newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar futures close at day's highs.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar futures close at day's highs.

text.p: White sugar futures regained ground to match their earlier intraday high at Wednesday's close but business as fairly thin and largely involved short covering, traders said.
Buying back hedges featured after the weekly European Union (EU) tender for export licences yielded lower results than had been forecast.
Most active August was down $1.80 at $329.00, the high struck earlier and October was $1.90 lower at $319.80.
The two front months dominated activity and accounted for 1,596 lots and 1,239 lots respectively.
The EU awarded 87,750 tonnes of current series white sugar at a maximum export rebate of 41.653 Ecus per 100 kilos, after 64,275 tonnes and 42.874 Ecus last week.
Paris Aug and Oct contracts closed down $1.3 at $328.3 and $1.7 at $319.3 respectively.
